name: Hourly ident
description: Speaks the time and the station name on the hour. Ships disabled because it talks on air.
author: nodecast

settingsSchema.label: What to say
settingsSchema.help: {time} and {station} are filled in when it is spoken.

settingsSchema.label: When
settingsSchema.help: 0 is on the hour. 30 would make it half past.

settingsSchema.label: Only while the station is on air
settingsSchema.help: Off means it speaks into a stopped station too.

settingsSchema.label: Language
settingsSchema.help: Leave empty to use the station's own language.
